fields: L6 Hong Kong / Mid-Autumn Festival (inline roller skates; Central → Victoria Harbour → The Peak). Same item fields as L3 v3.1 / L4 / L5. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = 月饼摊 Mooncake Stall questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh must equal choices; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12 where CJK=1, ASCII=0.5), peak_final = The Peak / 太平山顶 final (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational, no bare arithmetic). Per run: 3 timed stall in segment 1 + 4 fork in segment 2 + 2 timed stall and 1 Peak final in segment 3 = 10 (one stall pool, drawn as 5 then split 3+2; do not place all 5 timed questions in the first segment). Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Festival riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'), labelled Festival riddle: / 中秋谜：. Stems are deduped against all L1–L5 banks (all grades).

a reflection on absence, time, and the shared moon
choices_zh: 关于离别、时间和共看明月的思索
questions.explain_en: The lyric reflects on time, absence, and the moon.
questions.explain_zh: 这首词写的是时间、离别和月亮。

questions.subject: science
questions.q_en: On wet stones at the Peak lookout, Flora brakes her skates and needs more room to stop than on a dry Central street. The main reason is ____.
questions.q_zh: 太平山观景台的湿石面上，Flora 刹车要比在干燥的中环街上用更长的距离才能停住。主要原因是____。
choices: sound from the harbour pushing her
less friction on the wet surface
lantern light heating the wheels into jets
choices_zh: 灯光把轮子加热成了喷气装置
questions.explain_en: Water reduces friction, so stopping takes more distance.
questions.explain_zh: 水会减小摩擦，停下就要更长的距离。
questions.qtype_zh: 力与运动（摩擦/阻力/牛顿定律）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Lamp posts along the harbour carry flags in an arithmetic pattern: 20 on the first, 25 on the second, and so on. How many flags are on post 11?
questions.q_zh: 维港灯杆挂旗成等差：第 1 根 20 面，第 2 根 25 面，依此类推。第 11 根有多少面？
questions.qtype_zh: 等差数列第 n 项

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the Peak, 3 mooncakes are set out, and the number set out doubles every minute. After how many minutes are 48 mooncakes set out?
questions.q_zh: 太平山先摆出 3 块月饼，摆出的月饼数每分钟翻一倍。几分钟后摆出 48 块？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Mooncakes at the Peak are set out in rounds: 4 mooncakes in the first round, then 3 times as many each round, for 7 rounds. How many mooncakes in total?
questions.q_zh: 太平山的月饼分轮摆：第一轮 4 块，之后每轮是上一轮的 3 倍，共 7 轮，一共多少块？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: At the Peak, Flora may pick 2 of 11 different mooncakes to share. Order does not matter. How many different sets can she pick?
questions.q_zh: 在太平山，Flora 可以从 11 块不同的月饼里挑 2 块分享，不计顺序，有多少种挑法？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Mooncakes are set out in waves at the Peak: 2 at first, and the number set out multiplies by 3 each wave. How many are set out in wave 7, after 6 multiplications?
questions.q_zh: 太平山的月饼一波波摆出：开始 2 块，每一波是上一波的 3 倍。乘了 6 次之后（第 7 波）摆出多少块？
questions.qtype_zh: 指数增长/衰减求值（翻倍、等比）

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Flora has 76 m of lantern string to fence a rectangular mooncake area at the Peak. What is the largest possible area in m²?
questions.q_zh: Flora 有 76 米灯笼线，要在太平山围一块长方形放月饼的区域，最大面积是多少平方米？
questions.qtype_zh: 最值优化（定周长最大面积）
